get.description:
Returns a listing of attendees for a particular client. There is a limit of 100 attendees per page.

- **subaccounts** parameter conditions:
  - Value can be 1 or more child client ids (multiple values will need to be delimited by a comma).
  - Child client IDs must be under the {clientId} of the request
  - If **subaccounts** is provided and **excludeSubaccounts** is "Y", following error message is returned: *"You have to set excludesubaccounts='N' in order to filter by subaccounts.".*
  - If **subaccounts** includes multiple values and at least one value is not valid, an error message is returned.
  - When **subaccounts** is provided, the response will only return data for the child client ids included in the parameter
- **dateFilterMode** parameter conditions (not case-sensitive):
  - If the parameter is not included or no value is supplied, **startDate** and **endDate** will work in the manner they usually do.
  - "lastActivity" is the only supported value. When passed, the response will include only those attendees who have had activity between (and including) the provided **startDate** and **endDate**. Attendee lastActivity value is updated with new modified date whenever one of the following actions is performed by an attendee:
    - Starting new session
    - Refreshing browser during webcast presentation
    - Submitting poll answers
- **realtimeonly** parameter conditions (when "Y" is passed):
  - Properties that rely on the datawarehouse will not be included in the response, including:
    - engagementscore
    - firstliveactivity
    - lastliveactivity
    - firstarchiveactivity
    - lastarchiveactivity
    - askedquestions
    - resourcesdownloaded
    - answeredpolls
    - answeredsurveys
    - cumulativeliveminutes
    - cumulativearchiveminutes
    - Any activity / updates that have occurred in the last 15 minutes will be available in the response.

get.description:
Returns a listing of events for a particular client. Events belonging to sub-client accounts are not included in the response.

- If **startDate** and **endDate** are not sent, the response will return all events from the past 3 months.
- The **startDate** and **endDate** will filter the list of events based on **dateFilterMode** parameter value.
- If **includesubaccounts** is "Y", pagination will be required. Both **pageOffset** and **itemsPerPage** parameters will be available. Response schema differs.
- **subaccounts** parameter conditions:
  - Value can be 1 or more child client IDs (multiple values will need to be delimited by a comma).
  - Child client IDs must be under the {clientId} of the request.
  - If **subaccounts** is provided and **includeSubaccounts=N** (either explicitly or by default), the following error message is returned: *"You have to set includesubaccounts='Y' in order to filter by subaccounts.".*
  - If **subaccounts** includes multiple values and at least one value is not valid, an error message is returned.
  - When **subaccounts** is provided, the response will only return data for the child client IDs included in the parameter.
- **dateFilterMode** accepted values (not case-sensitive):
  - "goodafter" (default): date and time an event is first available for the audience.
  - "updated": filters based on "lastupdated" attribute in the response. It may be between 2 and 12 hours to see changes on "lastupdated". The "lastupdated" is the last time an event had audience activity as:
    - Event is created
    - New Registrant
    - New Attendee
    - Poll is answered
    - Survey is answered
  - "modified": filters based on "lastmodified" attribute in the response. "lastmodified" is the last time the event's information was modified.
  - "creation": date and time an event was created.
  - "livestart": date and time an event starts the live broadcasting.
  - "liveend": date and time an event ends the live broadcasting.
  - "archivestart": date and time an event will be available on-demand for the audience.
  - "archiveend": date and time an event won't be available anymore for the audience.
- **filterOrder** accepted values (not case-sensitive):
  - "asc" (default): ascending
  - "desc": descending
- **contentType** accepted values (not case-sensitive):
  - "all" (default)
  - "experience": Experience Hub contents
  - "gateway": Engagement Hub contents
  - "golive": Go Live events
  - "pdf": Documents from Media Manager library
  - "video": Videos from Media Manager library
  - "webcast": Elite webinars
  - "webpage": Links from Media Library
  - "forum": Forum events
- In the Client Level Events response, "eventlocation" is the same as the "campaigncode" (Campaign Code).

post.description:
Creates a new Webinar or Forum. When an existing event id is provided in query parameter **eventsource**, a copy of that event is created instead.

- When an existing event id is provided in query parameter **eventsource**, the new event created by this Endpoint will copy all the other fields from this existing event except the **liveStart** and **liveDuration**.
- Any of the parameters can be overridden, all parameters in the Event Creation are accepted.
- Required form parameters: **liveDuration** and **liveStart.**
- The copy process will copy the event source's tags (funnel, campaign, sales) and resources uploaded to it (PDF,mp4, etc)
- **liveDuration** parameter conditions:
  - When copying a webinar, users are able to provide a liveDuration value in 15 minute increments (e.g. 15, 30, 45, 60, etc.) up to 120 minutes.
  - Above 120 minutes, increments will be 30 minutes up to 480 minutes.
  - The maximum allowed liveDuration is 480 minutes.
- **liveStart** accepted date/time formats:
  - **MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm a** (08/26/2016 09:00 AM)
  - **YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss** Default timezone will be Pacific Time. (2016-08-26T09:00:00)
  - **YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss±zz:zz** where ±zz:zz is timezone's offset (2016-08-26T09:00:00-07:00)
  - JavaScript Date.toString() format is also supported (Wed Apr 04 2018 16:12:41 GMT+0200 (CEST) )
- **tagCampaign** parameter conditions:
  - When copying a webinar users are allowed to add up to 10 custom tags via the tagCampaign parameter.
  - Every tag that is associated with the webinar should be available in the **tags** array field in the response.
  - The following characters can not be used and will result in an error: £$!%&*()}{@#~?><',"|=_+¬
- **customAccountTag** parameter conditions:
  - Supported only for client accounts with enabled custom account tags.
  - When copying a webinar for an account with enabled custom account tags, users are allowed to add up to 3 tag IDs
  - Provided values must match configured client account values.
- **languageCd** / **countryCd** parameters conditions:
  - Following are allowed pairs of language/country values when copying an event:
    - Chinese (Simplified): languageCd=**"zh"**, countryCd=**"CN"**
    - Chinese (Traditional): languageCd=**"zh"**, countryCd=**"TW"**
    - English (UK): languageCd=**"en"**, countryCd=**"UK"**
  - For other languages, No countryCd is allowed.
- When copying a webinar, the following features will be copied from the source event unless their values are overriden:
  - Title. *In the following format: 'Copy of' + [source event name]*
  - Event Type
  - Duration
  - Language
  - Funnel Tags
  - Campaign Tags
  - Custom Account Tags
  - Registration page:
    - Banner
    - Registration fields
    - Page design
  - Email notifications configuration
  - Videos and Slides
  - Console customization
- **Elements that are not copied:**
  - Start time
  - Archive configuration
  - Security configuration

get.description:
Retrieves the metadata for derivative content in Media Manager.

Only returns content from the clientId specified in the request, and does not pull content from sub-accounts.

There is a limit of 100 contents per page.

Derivative content includes, and is limited to:

- Nurture Page
- Autogenerated Ebook
- Autogenerated Blog Post
- Autogenerated Key Takeaways
- Transcript

Content of type "Nurture Page" will always have a *contentid*.

Content of type "Nurture Page" will never have a *mediaid*.

Content of types "Autogenerated Ebook", "Autogenerated Blog Post", "Autogenerated Key Takeaways", and "Transcript" will always have a *mediaid*.

Content of types "Autogenerated Ebook", "Autogenerated Blog Post", "Autogenerated Key Takeaways", and "Transcript" will only have a *contentid* after they are published for the first time.

get.description:
Returns a listing of registrants for a particular client. There is a limit of 100 registrants per page.

- If double opt-in verification was enabled at the time of registration for an event, and a user has not completed the verification process, the user will not be included in any endpoint responses.
- **subaccounts** parameter conditions:
  - Value can be 1 or more child client IDs (multiple values will need to be delimited by a comma)
  - Child client IDs must be under the {clientId} of the request
  - If **subaccounts** is provided and **excludeSubaccounts=Y**, following error message is returned: *"You have to set excludesubaccounts='N' in order to filter by subaccounts.".*
  - If **subaccounts** includes multiple values, and at least one value is not valid, an error message is returned.
  - When **subaccounts** is provided, the response will only return the data of the child client IDs included in the parameter.
- **dateFilterMode** parameter options (not case-sensitive):
  - If the parameter is not included or no value is supplied, **startDate** and **endDate** will work in the manner they usually do.
  - "lastActivity" is the only supported value. When passed, the response will include only those registrants who have had activity between (and including) the provided startDate and endDate. Registrant lastActivity value is updated with new modified date whenever one of the following API endpoints gets invoked to modify the registration information:
    - REST Registration
    - Update Registrant (client-level)
    - Forget Registrant (client-level)
    - Forget All Registrant (client-level)
    - Forget All Registrant (event-level)

patch.description:
Updates all registrants for the given client using the PATCH method. This means that only those registration fields that are part of the request will be updated. Because the registration pages for the various events may have different required registration field or allowed values, there will be no validation of the formData values for this request.

If provided, the email parameter in the body of the request (formData) will replace the existing email address for all matching registrants found by the email parameter in the path of the request. Because the registrant's email address must be unique on a per-event basis, if the new email address matches any other registrants for that event, the update will be blocked, and an error message will be returned.
